info.title: Rancher
info.description: Rancher is a multi-cluster Kubernetes management platform from SUSE, providing centralized cluster provisioning, RBAC, and workload management across on-prem and cloud Kubernetes clusters through a management API exposed at /v3.

servers.description: Rancher server. This platform does not apply OpenAPI server variables/paths automatically — set the integration instance's server.base_path to "/v3".

host.description: Rancher server hostname or IP address (no protocol, no path).

200.description: Workload updated (e.g. to change scale or container image).
A collection of cluster role template bindings.

get.summary: Get Cluster Role Template Binding by ID

200.description: A collection of project role template bindings.

get.summary: Get Project Role Template Binding by ID

bearerAuth.description: Rancher API bearer token, formed by concatenating an API key's access key and secret key with a colon (<access-key>:<secret-key>), generated under User Avatar > API & Keys.

driverName.description: e.g. rancherKubernetesEngine, imported, eks, gke, aks.

k8sVersion.description: Kubernetes version reported for the cluster.

id.description: Namespace name, unique within its cluster.

projectId.description: Project the namespace is moved into (e.g. c-m-xxxxxxxx:p-xxxxx).

id.description: Composite ID in the form <kind>:<namespace>:<name>, e.g. deployment:default:my-app.

workloadType.description: deployment, statefulSet, daemonSet, job, or cronJob.

driver.description: Node driver name, e.g. amazonec2, azure, digitalocean, vmwarevsphere.
